## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall, handsome fellow with broad shoulders, curly brown hair, and roguish hazel eyes that are clear and straightforward. He is known for a mouth often twisted into a teasing smile, though at one point he appeared noticeably pale and thin.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 ch.Lady P58](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0058), [v3 ch.Weddings P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert is a clever, good-natured, and popular young man known for his teasing nature and keen sense of humor. Full of ambition and zest, he possesses a strong determination to excel, whether competing to be first in his class or aiming for High Honors and the Cooper Prize. He is motivated to live life to its fullest and is driven to become a doctor so he can do his share of honest work fighting disease, pain, and ignorance.

## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after three years in Alberta, where he had hardly attended school while caring for his sick father, and immediately resumed his studies alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their initial meeting resulted in [Anne](../character/anne.md) breaking a slate over his head after he teased her, sparking a fierce academic rivalry. During a dory accident on the pond, Gilbert rescued [Anne](../character/anne.md) and offered an apology, but she refused his friendship. The two later tied for first place on the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations and went on to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together, where Gilbert won the academic medal. Upon graduating, Gilbert gave up his secured teaching position in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) so that [Anne](../character/anne.md) could remain close to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), prompting a reconciliation between them. Together, they established the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) and maintained a close friendship while preparing for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). During their freshman year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Gilbert gained distinction by leading the Freshmen to victory in the Arts Rush and served as captain of the football team. His feelings for [Anne](../character/anne.md) deepened, but when he proposed to her in the garden at Patty's Place, she rejected him, insisting she only cared for him as a friend. Following the rejection, Gilbert began spending time with [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md), and he went on to win High Honors in Classics and the Cooper Prize upon completing his degree. Shortly after graduation, Gilbert suffered a severe case of typhoid fever back in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), but his fever broke and he recovered. Once restored to health, he asked [Anne](../character/anne.md) to walk with him to [Hester](../character/hester-gray.md) Gray's garden, where he proposed a second time, and she accepted.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> "Well, I must run up to MacPhersons’. Moody Spurgeon came home from Queen’s today for Sunday and he was to bring me out a book Professor Boyd is lending me."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P19](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0019)

> "You’re just tired, Anne. Come, forget it all and take a walk with me—a ramble back through the woods beyond the marsh. There should be something there I want to show you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P15](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0015)

> "No. I only know it should be, from something I saw there in spring. Come on. We’ll pretend we are two children again and we’ll go the way of the wind."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P17](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0017)

> "Here’s a fallen tree with a cushion of moss. Sit down, Anne—it will serve for a woodland throne. I’ll climb for some apples. They all grow high—the tree had to reach up to the sunlight."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P34](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0034)

> "I persist in dreaming it, although it has often seemed to me that it could never come true. I dream of a home with a hearth-fire in it, a cat and dog, the footsteps of friends—and you!"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Time P22](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0022)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne.md) began as bitter enemies when Gilbert pulled her hair and teased her, leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to hold a long grudge despite his attempts to apologize. Over time, their dynamic evolved through an intense academic rivalry into a close, supportive friendship as they prepared for higher education together. Eventually, their deep mutual bond and underlying affection transitioned into a romantic relationship.

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert's relationship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) started with an ill-advised insult that sparked her intense contempt and a fierce academic competition to be first in their class. Despite his early efforts to rescue her and make amends, [Anne](../character/anne.md) held onto her anger for years before they eventually put their hostility behind them. They later became close companions, collaborating as co-organizers for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society).

### [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and Charlie are long-standing friends who attended school together in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Their relationship features a quiet rivalry for the romantic favor of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). At times, [Anne](../character/anne.md) deliberately uses Charlie to spite Gilbert, such as choosing to walk home with Charlie after an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) farewell party.
